premise: The humble beginnings of a Delta blues legend who played on street corners before recording hits.
hook: He worked as a tractor driver in Mississippi cotton fields while earning coins by singing gospel and blues on street corners.
key_facts: Worked on a cotton plantation in Indianola, Mississippi, during his youth.
Traveled to Memphis, Tennessee, seeking a radio break, eventually working as a disc jockey known as the Beale Street Blues Boy.
Named his signature Gibson electric guitars 'Lucille' after an incident involving a tavern fire.
Recorded dozens of influential blues standards over a decades-long touring career.

premise: A college dropout builds a computer in his parents' garage with his friend during the 1970s tech boom.
hook: Before building iPhones, he dropped out of college, slept on friends' floors, and built circuit boards in a garage.
key_facts: Dropped out of Reed College after attending for one semester
Co-founded Apple Computer in 1976 inside a suburban garage
Traveled to India seeking spiritual guidance prior to starting Apple

premise: A struggling single mother writes fantasy chapters in Edinburgh cafes while depending on state benefits.
hook: Before selling millions of books, she wrote manuscript pages in local cafes while keeping warm with her baby.
key_facts: Conceived the idea for a wizarding school while on a delayed train in 1990.
Completed the first novel while living in Edinburgh amid financial hardship.
Faced multiple rejections from publishing houses before Bloomsbury accepted the manuscript.

premise: His grueling decade training at the China Drama Academy as a child.
hook: Before he broke box office records, he trained for 19 hours a day under a master who promised teachers could break their bones.
key_facts: Enrolled in the Beijing Opera School (China Drama Academy) at age six by his parents.
Trained rigorously in martial arts, acrobatics, singing, and acting for ten years.
Worked as a stuntman and extra in Bruce Lee films before landing leading roles.

premise: A routine bus ride in Montgomery, Alabama leads to an arrest that ignites a historic boycott.
hook: One quiet refusal on a crowded bus sparked a movement that changed history.
key_facts: Worked as a seamstress and NAACP secretary
Arrested for refusing to surrender her bus seat to a white passenger
Triggered the 381-day Montgomery bus boycott

premise: An experienced Sherpa mountaineer helps complete the first successful ascent of Mount Everest.
hook: He faced freezing winds and thin air to reach the roof of the world when previous expeditions had repeatedly failed.
key_facts: Participated in multiple Himalayan expeditions as a high-altitude porter
Reached the summit of Everest with Edmund Hillary in 1953
Named one of Time magazine's 100 most influential people of the 20th century

premise: An untidy laboratory bench and a contaminated petri dish lead to the discovery of penicillin.
hook: A messy lab and a stray mold spore accidentally launched modern antibiotics.
key_facts: Noticed mold growing on a staphylococcus culture plate in 1928
Identified the mold as Penicillium notatum inhibiting bacterial growth
Published foundational research that enabled mass antibiotic development

premise: A medical researcher chooses to test his experimental polio vaccine on himself and his family.
hook: He injected his own family with an untested virus to prove it was safe.
key_facts: Led the research team developing the first successful polio vaccine
Inoculated himself, his wife, and his children during early safety trials
Declared the vaccine patent-free to maximize global distribution

premise: A young chess prodigy in India sharpens his lightning-fast tactical skills in local clubs.
hook: Before becoming a world champion, he earned the nickname 'Lightning Kid' for his rapid moves.
key_facts: Became India's first Grandmaster in 1988
Won multiple World Chess Championships across different formats
Awarded India's highest civilian sporting honor, the Padma Vibhushan

premise: After his ship is crushed by Antarctic ice, an explorer leads his entire crew to survival.
hook: His ship was destroyed, yet every single member of his crew survived the polar wilderness.
key_facts: Led the Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition aboard the Endurance
Traversed 800 miles of stormy ocean in a small lifeboat to find rescue
Achieved zero loss of life despite months stranded on floating ice
